_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'is a research-based, global biopharmaceutical company. We apply science and our global resources to bring therapies to people that extend and significantly improve their lives through the discovery, development, manufacture, marketing, sale and distribution of biopharmaceutical products worldwide' (FY2023 10-K, Item 1); 'Certain of our products have experienced patent-based expirations or loss of regulatory exclusivity in certain markets in the last few years, and we expect certain products to face increased generic competition over the next few years' (Item 1A); 'when generic or biosimilar competition does commence, the resulting price competition can substantially decrease our revenues for the impacted products, often in a very short period of time' (Item 1A); 'Our business is conducted in intensely competitive and highly regulated markets'

classification.quality_note: 'is a research-based, global biopharmaceutical company. We apply science and our global resources to bring therapies to people that extend and significantly improve their lives through the discovery, development, manufacture, marketing, sale and distribution of biopharmaceutical products worldwide' (FY2023 10-K, Item 1); 'Certain of our products have experienced patent-based expirations or loss of regulatory exclusivity in certain markets in the last few years, and we expect certain products to face increased generic competition over the next few years' (Item 1A); 'when generic or biosimilar competition does commence, the resulting price competition can substantially decrease our revenues for the impacted products, often in a very short period of time' (Item 1A); 'Our business is conducted in intensely competitive and highly regulated markets'. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.13x; -62% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.24; conservative 2yr +209%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -71.3%/yr (worst year FY17-FY22, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +5.2%/yr (FY24 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 7.7-yr ex-FY23 median

BULL.desc: EPS +19.7%/yr (FY17-FY22 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +115.3%/yr (best 2-yr run FY17-FY22); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: PFE (retrospective, 2024-09-20) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.13x (93.2% downside to Bear $2 / +715.8% upside to Bull $240) | Adj composite 2.46 vs market 1.22: gap +1.24 [UNDERVALUED] | -62% above the EPP floor $77 (14x FY24E $5.47) | Conservative 2-yr case: +209.0% total (+104.5%/yr) | At 5.4x FY24E the 15% hurdle price $39 sits at or below the BASE case; U.S. revenues +22.2% in Q2 2024, forward revenues +1.7-6.8% (FY24 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
